Priya (RevOps): Heads-up — we're seeing reassign spikes when enrichment updates land a few seconds after ingest. Leads flip owner -> noisy alerts. Thinking a tiny hold on initial claims.
Evan (Growth): How small?
Priya (RevOps): Proposal: per-pool debounce window. Defaults: VIP=6s, Standard=25s. If enrichment still pending after TTL -> force assign to overflow.
Sofia (Sales Ops): We need to avoid duplicate "new lead" pings to AEs. Can we set a HS flag while held?
Ollie (Eng-Data): Yes — add hs prop `rd_hold=true` and `rd_hold_eta_seconds`. Router records metric `lead.hold.count` with pool tag.
Dana (Marketing Ops): Also please preserve `previous_owner` when reassign happens so we can audit churn.
Priya (RevOps): Will do. Pseudo: if enrichment_pending and now - ingest_ts < pool.window -> set hold, write prop, emit metric, skip assign.
hs-sync-bot: Will ignore owner writes when `rd_hold=true` and avoid double-sync.
Evan (Growth): Rollout: feature flag -> 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with 24h observation.
Ollie (Eng-Data): I'll add dashboards: hold.count, reassign.30s.rate, enrichment.latency.p95. Alert if reassign rate > 4%. Backfill last 7 days.
Sofia (Sales Ops): UX: show tiny HS badge "Pending enrichment — ownership held" and optionally a slack ephemeral note for VIPs only.
Priya (RevOps): Action items: Ollie add metrics/backfill (EOD), Eng add hold logic & per-pool config (48h), Dana draft AE messaging + slack snippet (tomorrow), I'll own rollout doc.
Dana (Marketing Ops): I'll also update handoff playbook language to mention possible 25s hold for enrichment.
Evan (Growth): Nice — good operational story for kickoff.
Priya (RevOps): Great. If we see any elevated unassigned_after_ttl events during canary we rollback. I'll post RFC link in #marketing-release when ready.
